messages:
deploybot: [ALERT] Canary for model-serving in us-east1 shows 13% 5xx and unhealthy readiness probes. Rollout paused automatically. Need expedited decision: pin to previous stable or abort.

cecilia: Noted. Any immediate customer impact?

ashok: Some user requests returned empty embeddings. Traces point to a changed tokenizer behavior in v3.4.1-canary.

cecilia: My vote is to pin to redwood/model-serving:v3.4.0-stable and scale canary down. Ops, can you run the pin and monitor for 20m?

ops_oncall: I can take it now. If pinned, I'll watch error_rate, p99 latency, and pod restarts. If error_rate > 5% after 10m, we open incident.

ashok: Executing pin:
```
/releasebot pin --service model-serving --image redwood/model-serving:v3.4.0-stable --reason "canary regression v3.4.1" --urgency expedited --owner ashok
```

releasebot: Pin acknowledged. Validating image signature... OK. Applying pin and rebalancing traffic. ETA ~30s.

deploybot: Reroute complete. Traffic now on redwood/model-serving:v3.4.0-stable. v3.4.1 scaled to zero.

ops_oncall: Monitoring: error_rate back to baseline ~0.4%, p99 normalized. Holding for 20m.

cecilia: Drafting internal release note and tagging owners for postmortem.

ashok: I'll start a bisect on tokenizer changes.

ops_oncall: +22m stable. No further anomalies. Closing expedited window. Marking resolved. :white_check_mark:
